listing:

  template: listing-mosaic.ejs
  contents: "*/index.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: false
  filter-ui: false
  sort-ui: false
---

```{=html}
<div class="pg">
  <header class="pg-head">
    <div class="pg-head__main">
      <p class="pg-eyebrow rise">Writing</p>
      <h1 class="pg-title rise d1">Blog &amp; notes</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="pg-head__aside rise d2">
        <p class="pg-lead">A place to think out loud about disease modelling, code, and the work of science.</p>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="blg-filter" id="blg-filter" role="group" aria-label="Filter posts by tag">
    <div class="blg-filter__opts scroll-x" id="blg-fopts"><span class="blg-filter__h">Show</span></div>
    <span class="blg-count" id="blg-count" aria-live="polite"></span>
  </div>
```

```{=html}
  <nav class="pg-next hue-bl" aria-label="Next page">
    <a href="../about/index.html">
      <span class="nx-main"><span class="nx-label">Next page</span><span class="nx-title">About</span></span>
      <span class="nx-text">Education, experience, impact, funding and the places research has taken me.</span>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17L17 7M8 7h9v9"/></svg>
    </a>
  </nav>
</div>

<script>
// Tag filter, built from the tags that have posts. No library.
// Each card carries its topic (data-topic, data-label, data-hue) and its tags (data-tags: the
// topic, plus "til" for a Today I learned note). listing-mosaic.ejs writes them from the topic
// list in blog/_metadata.yml, so the labels and colours live in one place. Each filter looks
// like the tag it shows: a topic in its colour, Today I learned as an outline.
// The address keeps the choice, so /blog/#til links to the TIL notes.
// Quarto links the tags at the top of each post to /blog/#category=<tag>; that works too.
(function () {
  // The cards come from a custom template, so Quarto's own listing script never builds its
  // list. Give it an empty one, so it does not throw an error when the address (#...) changes.
  window['quarto-listings'] = window['quarto-listings'] || {};
  var grid = document.getElementById('blg-grid'), opts = document.getElementById('blg-fopts'), count = document.getElementById('blg-count');
  if (!grid || !opts) return;
  var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(grid.querySelectorAll('.blg-card'));
  function tagsOf(c) { return (c.getAttribute('data-tags') || '').split(' '); }
  // the topics in order of their newest post, and how many posts each tag has
  var tally = {}, topics = [];
  cards.forEach(function (c) {
    var t = c.getAttribute('data-topic');
    if (t && !tally[t]) { tally[t] = 0; topics.push({ key: t, label: c.getAttribute('data-label'), hue: c.getAttribute('data-hue') }); }
    if (t) tally[t]++;
    if (tagsOf(c).indexOf('til') >= 0) tally.til = (tally.til || 0) + 1;
  });
  function label(n) { return n + (n === 1 ? ' post' : ' posts') + ', newest first'; }
  function add(key, text, n, cls) {
    var b = document.createElement('button'), s = document.createElement('span'), i = document.createElement('i');
    b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'blg-fopt' + (cls ? ' ' + cls : ''); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'); b.dataset.filter = key;
    s.textContent = text; i.textContent = n; s.appendChild(i); b.appendChild(s);
    opts.appendChild(b);
  }
  // All posts, then Today I learned (a kind of post), then the topics
  add('all', 'All posts', cards.length);
  if (tally.til) add('til', 'Today I learned', tally.til, 'blg-fopt--kind');
  topics.forEach(function (t) { add(t.key, t.label, tally[t.key], 'blg-fopt--topic hue-' + t.hue); });
  function apply(f) {
    if (f !== 'all' && !tally[f]) f = 'all';
    var shown = 0;
    opts.querySelectorAll('.blg-fopt').forEach(function (x) { x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x.dataset.filter === f ? 'true' : 'false'); });
    cards.forEach(function (c) { var show = f === 'all' || tagsOf(c).indexOf(f) >= 0; c.hidden = !show; if (show) shown++; });
    count.textContent = label(shown);
    // on a phone the options are one line that scrolls sideways: keep the chosen one in view
    var on = opts.querySelector('.blg-fopt[aria-pressed="true"]');
    if (on && opts.scrollWidth > opts.clientWidth) {
      var o = opts.getBoundingClientRect(), r = on.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.left < o.left + 6 || r.right > o.right - 36) opts.scrollLeft += r.left - o.left - 18;
    }
    return f;
  }
  function fromHash() {
    var h;
    try { h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)).toLowerCase().replace(/^category=/, ''); } catch (e) { return 'all'; }
    return h === 'today i learned' ? 'til' : (h || 'all');
  }
  apply(fromHash());
  opts.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.blg-fopt') : null;
    if (!b) return;
    var f = apply(b.dataset.filter);
    history.replaceState(null, '', f === 'all' ? location.pathname + location.search : '#' + f);
  });
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', function () { apply(fromHash()); });
})();
</script>
```
